verdict: HTTP 503 from WSUS. The `WsusPool` application pool on the SUP has stopped or is recycling under memory pressure.
fix: On the SUP, `Import-Module WebAdministration; Get-WebAppPoolState -Name WsusPool`. If `Stopped`, `Start-WebAppPool -Name WsusPool`. Prevent recurrence by setting `Private Memory Limit` to 0 and `Queue Length` to 30000 on the WsusPool. If the pool stops again quickly, the WSUS content database is bloated - run `Invoke-WsusServerCleanup` with all switches, and shrink the SUSDB index rebuild job.
